course_position.stage_name: Solid B1+ to Low B2 Development

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Use concession and contrast to discuss healthy habits and realistic obstacles.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Talking about exercise, food, sleep, costs, and time in everyday adult routines.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Acknowledging an obstacle while still explaining a practical viewpoint.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss whether healthy routines are mostly about motivation, time, money, or planning.

main_focus.name: contrast and concession with även om, däremot, and samtidigt
main_focus.description: Use contrast and concession phrases to present a nuanced but practical opinion.
model_examples: Även om det kostar mer, kan det vara värt det ibland.
Däremot är det svårt att träna när veckan är full.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use concession or contrast 4-5 times, including at least one sentence with även om.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use everyday health and routine vocabulary without becoming medical or prescriptive.

dialogue_shape.opening: A general discussion about healthy routines is introduced.
dialogue_shape.middle: They compare motivation, time, cost, and realistic planning with concession and contrast.
dialogue_shape.ending: They reach a practical, balanced conclusion.

target_complexity.repetition: The focus is nuance in everyday opinion, not giving professional health advice.

focus: the obstacle that makes healthy routines difficult
the contrast between an ideal habit and a realistic habit
the balanced conclusion about what is practical

sentence_focus: one sentence saying something is worth it under a condition
one sentence giving a realistic conclusion
